lines.say: its compounds stimulated nerve growth factor (lab studies)
better thinking scores in mild cognitive impairment and mild Alzheimer's (2 small trials)
no lasting memory or thinking gains in healthy adults (small trials)
lower depression and anxiety scores in two small randomized trials
stomach discomfort, nausea or diarrhea in some trials; reporting often incomplete
severe lung reaction (ARDS) in one long-term user, possibly allergic; cause unproven
